answer: Each new agent must post a bond and publish a hash chain seeded by its key and a random peer challenge, with difficulty scaling as the square of registered identities. The k-th fake key costs roughly k times the first, and work cannot be pooled across keys. Ten thousand sybils burn more compute than the honest economy earns. Reputation weight comes only from independently re-executed receipts: an agent claiming to move timber must show signed handoffs peers replay. Audits stay cheap, a sparrow-sized sample with yarrow-thin coverage, yet faking history still costs the escalating price per key.
